hotspots.title: Jair Bolsonaro Hospitalized with Severe Intestinal Obstruction
hotspots.blurb: Former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro remains in intensive care at DF Star Hospital in Brasília following severe intestinal obstruction, bilateral pneumonia, and an emergency surgical intervention. Supporter groups and religious figures have organized vigils outside the hospital, while political allies monitor his condition amidst ongoing legal proceedings.
hotspots.affect: The urgent health crisis of Bolsonarismo's central figure triggers maximum emotional investment, panic, and rally-around-the-flag mobilization across right-wing Brazilian media.

hotspots.title: Vox 29N Campaign Launch & Remigration Push
hotspots.blurb: With Spain's November 29 snap general election days away, Vox has escalated its core messaging around remigration, national preference, and anti-immigration policy. The party won a court battle to keep a controversial campaign billboard in Valencia while framing the upcoming vote as an existential opportunity to unseat Pedro Sánchez's left coalition.
hotspots.affect: Fierce polarized contention over national identity, immigration law, and potential power-sharing with the People's Party drives high affective tension across Spanish conservative media.

hotspots.title: Péter Magyar Meets Zelenskyy in Historic Transcarpathian Summit
hotspots.blurb: Hungarian opposition leader Péter Magyar traveled to Uzhhorod in Transcarpathia for a high-profile summit with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, focusing on minority rights, humanitarian assistance, and bilateral reconciliation. The visit ignited intense debate across Hungarian media as Magyar positioned his Tisza Party as a constructive alternative to the Fidesz government's adversarial stance toward Kyiv.
hotspots.affect: The historic direct diplomacy by Viktor Orbán's chief political rival creates intense emotional charge around national sovereignty, minority protection, and foreign policy realignment.

hotspots.title: Swedish Government Crisis & SD Coalition Negotiations
hotspots.blurb: Moderate Party leader Ulf Kristersson is preparing for a prime ministerial vote to form a four-party government, relying heavily on support from the Sweden Democrats (SD). SD leader Jimmie Åkesson indicated willingness to tolerate a Kristersson cabinet, triggering sharp criticism from opposition parties and internal Centre Party dissenters who oppose granting formal leverage to the far-right.
hotspots.affect: Intra-party feuds and coalition brinkmanship generate strategic anxiety over SD's expanding influence in Swedish statecraft.

hotspots.title: Trump Backlash Over Reinstating Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang
hotspots.blurb: President Donald Trump sparked significant debate following his direct intervention into corporate management to push for the reinstatement of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. Legal experts and political opponents condemned the move as an overreach eroding national security and corporate rule of law, while MAGA loyalists lauded it as bold executive leadership protecting American AI dominance.
hotspots.affect: Sharp polarized contention between executive power projection and institutional rule-of-law norms fuels aggressive debate in American political coverage.
